response.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS average_net_fee_rate FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005

assumptions.assumption: High-rebate means the maker rebate rate is strictly greater than 0.0005.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff includes fee records with a maker rebate rate of exactly 0.0005.
